outcome: failure of bilateral sentinel lymph node (SLN) mapping with indocyanine green (ICG)
cohort: The study included 110 patients with endometrial cancer apparently confined to the uterus who underwent laparoscopic surgical staging with SLN mapping.
finding: The surgeon was the only significant factor associated with the success of bilateral SLN mapping, while neither obesity nor the presence of lymph node metastases was associated with mapping failure.
